newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Richter hits high on demand, arbitrage.
newsitem.headline: Richter hits high on demand, arbitrage.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian pharmaceuticals company Richter Gedeon Rt powered ahead to a new record high of 12,800 forints on Monday, bolstered by foreign demand and arbitrage, traders said.
At 1044 GMT Richter shares stood at 12,750 forints, up from Friday's close of 12,310.

"Quite a strong foreign demand was generated at 12,500 forints," said Peter Nagy of Postabank Securities. "Also, arbitrage has started between the spot and the futures market and arbitrage has also been driving it up."
Traders said Richter's supply side was not particularly strong, while demand has emerged ahead of its planned new phase of privatisation.
